scenes.stage_direction: Calls and protected interviews interrupt the search. Amara asks practical questions about Ethan's care before she asks about blame.

dialogues.speaker: Detective Morris
dialogues.text: We need to find Lami safely. We do not yet know whether she is hiding from us or from the people who hired her.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: The pin belonged to a former attendant named Lami.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: I know her face. She used to step aside when the family came down the stairs.
